hypothesis: The absent explicit C door-array allocator in JS might lose entries or shift room slices incorrectly at capacity boundaries.
expectedBehavior: Preserve logical coordinates and each room slice while growing storage; repeated registration of an existing door in the same room does not duplicate it.
observedBehavior: Twelve targets (two boundary-door densities, ordinary/secret types, three interleaved registration sequences) and three empty-map controls compare eight stages each. Exact C alloc_doors/add_door/inside_room/maybe_add_door/add_doors_to_room match actual exported JS add_doors_to_room. Each target reaches 72 or162 logical entries, crossing four or nine allocation increments of20, while every individual room doorct remains0..127. All logical coordinates, room fdoor/doorct pairs and total counts match; repeat calls are idempotent.
